limitations: CP-0008 proves exactly one source-pinned gfx950 wave64, one-CU, one-workgroup AQL fixture through the real HSAPacketProcessor, GPUCommandProcessor, GPUDispatcher, and compute-unit path. It does not prove arbitrary packets, geometry, kernels, HSACO or ELF/MsgPack loading, relocation, generic code-object ABI, ROCr/libhsakmt provider behavior, HIP, OpenCL, Triton, PyTorch, vLLM, multi-CU or multi-workgroup scheduling, collectives, tensor parallelism, model execution, or performance timing.

The CP7 signal mirror is a generation-checked host bridge listener for the pinned packet-retirement boundary; the AQL completion_signal remains HSA special handle zero and this does not establish general GPU signal-memory semantics.
The exact XOR output and positive GPU statistics are fixture evidence only; they do not establish a general kernel compiler, instruction-set, memory-coherence, or numerical model contract.
N=1/2/3/4/8 topology, queue, memory, signal, and endpoint tests remain independent-daemon isolation evidence, not cross-rank collectives or tensor-parallel execution.
Binaries, generated gem5 output, raw-wire logs, dispatch traces, statistics, and process logs remain ignored external acceptance artifacts and are not tracked source.
